name: teamusage
description: Sends this machine's coding-agent token counts to your team's self-hosted teamusage server after each session and during one at most every 4 hours, and adds skills and MCP tools to send and view usage

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Address of your team's teamusage server, for example https://usage.example.com. Plain http is accepted only for localhost unless you allow insecure HTTP below.

invite_code.title: Invite code
invite_code.description: The team's invite code from whoever runs the server. Stored in the system's secure credential store, not in settings.json.

name.title: Your name
name.description: Your name as the team dashboard shows it.

email.title: Your email
email.description: Your email. It identifies you on the server; the same email on several machines counts as one person.

allow_insecure_http.title: Allow insecure HTTP
allow_insecure_http.description: Allow a plain http:// server on a non-local address. The invite code and token are then sent unencrypted and can be read on the network. Leave this off and use HTTPS.
